note: Ranks are MHR’s Nov 11 ratings; they move live as results come in. Game times are local to the rink.

summary: A big Detroit-area showcase (BELFOR Training Center, Dearborn, Hazel Park) has a large part of the top 25: Little Caesars (#3), Team Illinois (#5), Nashville (#8), Top Gun (#10), Pittsburgh Penguins Elite (#11), Biggby (#18), Boston Jr Eagles (#19), NJ Colonials (#21), Seacoast (#22) and St. Louis Blues (#25), plus top Ontario U15 teams.
Chicago Mission (#6, 97.10) sits just 0.01 behind Team Illinois (#5, 97.11). Mission has no games listed on MHR this weekend, so Team Illinois can open up the gap in Detroit.
Mid-Fairfield (#1), Shattuck (#2), Woodbridge (#4) and Mount St Charles (#7) have no games posted on MHR yet.
